environment.description: Kubernetes 1.28 cluster with Pod Security Standards enforced at namespace level via label 'pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: restricted'. The namespace also carries 'pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce-version: v1.28'. Additionally, a ValidatingAdmissionPolicy (CEL-based) rejects any pod spec where spec.containers[*].securityContext.runAsNonRoot != true OR spec.volumes[*].hostPath is defined. The SMTP sidecar container (envoy-based) runs as UID 65534 with readOnlyRootFilesystem: true and drops ALL capabilities. Outbound SMTP connections are proxied through the sidecar which performs RFC 5322 header validation rejecting any header value containing CR or LF characters before forwarding to the upstream MTA. The sidecar's Envoy filter chain includes a Lua filter that parses raw SMTP DATA commands and returns 554 if bare newlines are detected in header fields. Network policy restricts egress on port 25 exclusively to the sidecar's loopback interface.

config.smtp_sidecar: envoy with RFC5322 header validation lua filter
config.smtp_sidecar_rejects: CRLF/LF in header field values (554 response)
